business_scope.primary_industry_name: High-Precision Lathe Turning of Foldable Hydrophobic Cataract Lenses

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic influence with modern commercial arbitration and corporate law)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: 1) Ley 526 de 1999 (establishes the Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero - UIAF and the general AML/CFT framework). 2) Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, Book 3 (AML/CFT prudential rules for supervised sectors). 3) Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada - SAS). 4) Decreto 1674 de 2021 and UIAF/DIAN implementing resolutions (obligatory Ultimate Beneficial Owner Registry - Registro de Beneficiarios Finales). 5) Circular Externa 004 de 2021 of the Superintendencia de Sociedades regarding beneficiary final identification. 6) Resolution CONALT 255 de 2022 and other UIAF instructions on PEP, sanctions, and beneficial ownership screening.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing of the foreign corporate shareholder (certificado de existencia y representación legal o equivalente extranjero)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent commercial registry or corporate registrar in the country of origin of the intended shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the foreign shareholder's bylaws or constitutional charter translated into Spanish by certified translator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or registered translator in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney (poder especial) for incorporation formalities before the Cámara de Comercio and DIAN
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction where the shareholder or legal representative is located

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copy and official ID of all UBOs, legal representatives, and board members
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority, notary, or competent civil registry office of the issuing country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank compliance reference letter and no-criminal-record certificate for each UBO and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating bank and national police/registro de antecedentes penales directory

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and legal representatives against OFAC SDN, UN Consolidated List, EU Consolidated List, UK OFSI, and the Colombian UIAF 'Reportes de Operaciones Sospechosas' framework. Enhanced due diligence for PEPs as defined in Colombian Decree 830 de 2021 and Resolution 255 de 2022, including person-to-person PEP determination, source-of-funds verification, and transaction monitoring. For a manufacture of intraocular acrylic lenses classified as High_Risk_Special_License, additional anti-money-laundering protocols apply because the product is subject to INVIMA sanitary registration and international trade through SWIFT and letters of credit, requiring open-banking and Swift-message due diligence under Colombian Circular 004 de 2021 and OFAC compliance guidelines.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) - www.ruees.gov.co and the online name-reservation system of the Cámara de Comercio del domicilio (normally Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá or the active chamber in the chosen department).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed corporate name may be in Spanish or in a Latin-script foreign language; however, all public registration documents and the bylaws must be filed in Spanish. If the name is in a non-Latin script, a certified Spanish transliteration and translation must be submitted. The statutory suffix 'S.A.S.' must appear at the end of the name. Names must not be identical to an existing trade name in the same economic sector, and they must be consistent with the current commercial nomenclature of the Cámara de Comercio.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected by the Cámara de Comercio, the applicant may file a written reconsideration (recurso de reposición) with the same chamber within 10 working days. If the rejection is upheld, a subsidiary administrative appeal (recurso de apelación) may be filed with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) within 5 working days after notification. Alternatively, the applicant may immediately submit a new name reservation and pay the applicable fee. The appeal must include the RUES registration number, the precise grounds of rejection, and a supporting legal memorandum showing that the name does not infringe Third Revised Colombian Trademark Law protections.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For an efficient-back-office SAS within the medical device sector, a virtual office is acceptable as a legal mailing address and administrative domicile for corporate compliance filings, but the company must maintain a physical, verifiable manufacturing or storage facility registered with the Cámara de Comercio and with the INVIMA sanitary authorities. The INVIMA operating license requires an actual establishment for high-risk intraocular lens production; a virtual office cannot serve as the sole registered establishment.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High_Risk_Unannounced_Inspection_Probability_80_Percent: unannounced annual INVIMA inspections are expected because the ISIC 3250 activity covers Class III implantable medical devices; a targeted on-site visit probability over the first 12 months of operation is approximately 80%. Cámara de Comercio routine verification of registered office probability is approximately 30%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and reservation fee (RUES / Cámara de Comercio)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official tariff determined by the local chamber under Decree 1074 of 2015 (variable between USD 3 and USD 10)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization fee for SAS incorporation private document, minute book, and Spanish translation of foreign shareholder documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff under Decreto 250 of 2016 and current Metropolitan notarial fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registry incorporation fee, registration of bylaws, and issuance of certificate of existence and legal representation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff indexed to the Seguro Obligatorio de Accidentes de Tránsito (SOAT) value

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registry filing preparation and submission to the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (RBF)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio / UIAF reporting agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Compliance fee for collecting and electronically uploading the ultimate beneficial ownership report and maintaining the RBF annual update

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Tax identification (RUT) registration and DIAN electronic signature procurement
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory fee; costs absorbed by the DIAN administrative budget

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille certification and consular legalization processing for foreign corporate documents and powers of attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille/authentication authority in the foreign shareholder's country
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market standard cost per document (USD 40-80 per document, estimated here for 4 primary documents)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INVIMA pre-incorporation sanitary consultation fee (class III intraocular lens manufacturing authorization preliminary assessment)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos (INVIMA)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: INVIMA tariff under Acuerdo 99 of 2021 or current ministerial fee table for laboratory/manufacturing authorization of Class III devices

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal and management consulting fee for corporate structuring, AML/CFT compliance frameworks, and foreign direct investment registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for boutique cross-border corporate compliance and AML/CFT advice in Bogotá

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas), Articles 1, 5, 17, 22 and 45; Commercial Code (Decree 410 of 1971), Articles 98, 99, 110, 127 and 137; Decree 1074 of 2015, Book 2, Title II (Mercantile Registry rules).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the principal domicile (Mercantile Registry), operated through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES); official oversight by Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (Private Incorporation Instrument) registered with the Mercantile Registry of the competent Chamber of Commerce; a public deed is required only if real property assets are contributed to the company.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Law 1258/2008 imposes no minimum paid-up capital. Subscribed capital may be paid in cash or in kind and the unpaid balance must be contributed within two years of registration unless the bylaws shorten the term. No statutory escrow account is required; payment is controlled by anti-money-laundering verification and share-subscription statements filed with the Chamber of Commerce.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — [COMPANY] S.A.S.

The founding shareholder convenes and resolves:

1. The incorporation instrument is approved, including the corporate purpose for manufacturing foldable hydrophobic acrylic intraocular lenses and the capital contribution schedule.

2. The registered office is fixed at [address], Colombia.

3. [Name] is elected Legal Representative and [Name] as Compliance Officer.

4. The Legal Representative is authorized to register the company with the Chamber of Commerce, DIAN, INVIMA, ANLA, local fire department and banks, and to sign all license, lease, bank and regulatory filings.

5. Corporate books are opened and legalized; subscribed shares are issued.

6. All prior acts are ratified and continuing resolutions are delegated to the Legal Representative.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Availability Check and Preparation of Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the company's principal domicile via the RUES online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name-availability application in the RUES system to obtain the Certificado de Homologación de Nombre. Draft the private incorporation instrument containing the company name, principal domicile, corporate purpose for intraocular lens manufacturing, duration, share classes, capital contribution schedule and appointment of the legal representative. Execute the document before witnesses or notarize if real property is contributed.
required_dossiers: Name availability certificate (Certificado de Homologación)
Draft bylaws (Estatutos Sociales)
Identity document or passport of each shareholder
Statement of subscribed and paid-up capital
Proof of the registered-office address
Special power of attorney if a representative signs on behalf of a shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused or reserved by a third party, file a corrective name request through RUES and present alternate names. If the name certificate expires before registration, apply for a new certificate within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution, Capital Payment and Chamber of Commerce Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Registro Mercantil) and a Notary Public only where real-property contributions exist
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After execution of the incorporation instrument and confirmation of capital subscription, file the instrument and all required annexes with the Chamber of Commerce or through the RUES digital channel. Pay the commercial registration fees and municipal taxes. Upon review, the Chamber registers the company, assigns registration data and issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal.
required_dossiers: Executed private incorporation instrument or notarized public deed
Name availability certificate
Subscribed capital payment voucher or in-kind contribution report
RUT of shareholders when applicable
Power of attorney for the filing agent
Completed Chamber of Commerce registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues observations, correct the instrument by a supplementary private statement and resubmit. If the legal-representation clause is inadequate, amend the bylaws and refile. Administrative denials may be appealed before the same Chamber within ten business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Identification and RUT Registration with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – Registro Único Tributario
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the NIT automatically generated after Chamber registration or through DIAN enrollment. Complete the RUT electronic form, confirming the natural and juridical status, tax classification as an industrial manufacturer, VAT responsibility, and activity code ISIC 3250. Request electronic invoicing authorization and register the legal representative and signatories for fiscal compliance.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation issued by the Chamber of Commerce
Identity document of the legal representative
Completed RUT forms and preliminary information sheet
Email and telephone contact data
If applicable, power of attorney for the accountant or tax agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the RUT application due to inconsistencies, correct the underlying Chamber data first and then present an adjustment through DIAN. Reconsideration requests may be filed within ten business days using the receipt of the queried application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Governance Formalities and Beneficial Ownership Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio for book legalization; Superintendencia de Sociedades for SAS compliance oversight
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the First Board Resolution and ratify the appointment of the Legal Representative and Compliance Officer. Open the share registry and minutes book, then request their legalization and foliation from the Chamber of Commerce. Record issued shares, transfers and beneficiary information. File the beneficial ownership declaration with DIAN/RUES and present the mandatory SAS financial information report to the Superintendencia de Sociedades when asset or revenue thresholds are exceeded.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution minutes
Share registry and minutes book
RUT and NIT certificate
Sworn statement of beneficial owners
Identity documents of the Legal Representative and Compliance Officer
Certificates of share subscription and payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber refuses book legalization because of formatting defects, correct the physical or digital format and resubmit. Missing beneficial-ownership filings may be submitted late with the applicable penalty; corporate acts can be ratified by a universal shareholder meeting if a defect is detected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: INVIMA Sanitary Registration and Good Manufacturing Practices Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INVIMA – Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos, Dirección de Dispositivos Médicos
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Classify the acrylic intraocular lens medical device under Decree 4725 of 2005 and submit the sanitary registration application. Arrange for pre-inspection of the production and clean-room facility. Submit the technical dossier covering design, materials, biocompatibility, sterilization, packaging and performance testing. Obtain the Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (BPM) and pay the applicable health registration tariff.
required_dossiers: INVIMA sanitary registration application form
Technical dossier and right-of-use of technical information
ISO 13485 quality management system certificate
ISO 10993 biocompatibility test reports
Sterilization validation report
ISO 11979 performance test report for intraocular lenses
Labeling, instructions for use and packaging specifications
Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
RUT and manufacturing-facility location evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If INVIMA issues a requerimiento de información, respond within the statutory term and request one extension where permitted. If the sanitary registration is denied, file recurso de reposición within ten business days and supplement any technical gaps, especially biocompatibility or sterility evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental, Fire Safety and Occupational Health Licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) or the applicable Corporación Autónoma Regional; local Cuerpo de Bomberos; ARL insurer and local labor authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Determine the environmental authorization tier for the lens manufacturing operation. File the environmental registration or impact declaration as required. Obtain wastewater discharge authorization and hazardous-waste generator registration where process wastewater or acrylic waste is generated. Submit the fire-safety plan and request the fire department inspection. Register the work-appointed SG-SST system with the ARL and obtain the workplace occupational clearance or inspection report.
required_dossiers: Environmental assessment, registration or impact declaration form
Wastewater and air emission characterization results
Hazardous waste management plan and generator registration certificate
Fire safety inspection application, facility plans and extinguisher reports
SG-SST plan and ARL affiliation proofs
Occupational health and ergonomic protocols for the lens machining area
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the environmental permit is refused or conditioned, file a written reconsideration and correct any noncompliance with applicable emission tables. Temporary fire-safety certificates may be granted pending correction of structural or extinguishing deficiencies. Occupational inspection findings are cured within the prescribed period and a follow-up inspection is requested.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: INVIMA – Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos, Dirección de Dispositivos Médicos; coordinated with the Ministry of Health and Social Protection and the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio for market surveillance
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Sanitario de Dispositivo Médico (Sanitary Registration of Medical Device) and Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (Good Manufacturing Practices Certificate) for the production of sterile intraocular acrylic lenses

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and the applicable Corporación Autónoma Regional for local environmental permitting
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration/Declaration tier for a medium-low-impact precision manufacturing plant; full Environmental Impact Assessment is not required unless production capacity or chemical handling triggers the thresholds of Decree 1076 of 2015; environmental registration, discharge permits and hazardous waste reporting are mandatory for point-source wastewater, VOC emissions and acrylic waste.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Comply with the discharge parameter limits applicable to manufacturing facilities under Resolution 0631 of 2015, including pH neutralization and oil-water separation before sewer discharge. Air emissions, including VOCs from acrylic machining, must comply with Resolution 2254 of 2017 for stationary sources and occupational hazard limits. Hazardous acrylic waste is managed in accordance with Decree 1076 of 2015 and the generator registration regime.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the local Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos after inspection of extinguishers, emergency exits, clean-room isolation and storage of acrylic monomers and solvents. Structural and load inspections are accepted by the municipal civil defense or zoning office. Workplace clearance requires an approved Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) registered with the ARL, including industrial hygiene controls for airborne particulates from lens lathe turning.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); electronic portal: MUISCA at www.dian.gov.co; electronic invoicing and customs declaration APIs under DIAN Web Services.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned S.A.S. first registers its incorporation deed with the Cámara de Comercio; through its legal representative or attorney-in-fact, it files the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) application in MUISCA, attaching the incorporation certificate, ID documents, and Colombian tax domicile. DIAN issues the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria), which is used for income tax, VAT, and customs purposes. No separate VAT registration ID is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: There is no Colombian check-the-box or general passthrough election. An S.A.S. is mandatorily treated as a separate taxable entity. Available elections include tax-neutral reorganization rules, the 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' for small businesses under statutory thresholds, and legal stability contracts or mega-investment agreements approved by the national government. Hybrid mismatch elections are not separately available; BEPS-style rules operate by default.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT — Impuesto al Valor Agregado (IVA), administered by DIAN
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary threshold for legal entities; an S.A.S. must register in the RUT as a 'régimen común' VAT-responsible person before commencing taxable operations. Simplified-régime thresholds (e.g., prior-year gross income below 3,500 UVT) apply only to natural persons and are irrelevant to this entity.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All sales, including exports, require a DIAN-validated electronic sales invoice (Factura Electrónica de Venta). The taxpayer transmits the XML via DIAN Web Services/API with an X.509 certificate; DIAN performs near-real-time validation and returns a CUFE/CUDE corresponding number and QR stamp. Export invoices must be validated before the customs export declaration and must use the configured export operation code.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The sale of intraocular acrylic lenses is zero-rated for VAT if the goods are physically exported from Colombia, the seller is a DIAN-registered 'régimen común' taxpayer, the DIAN-validated electronic export invoice is issued, and the export is effected under a definitive customs export declaration. The exporter must substantiate the real exit of the goods and, for related-party exports, maintain transfer pricing documentation to support the export price.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación - DEX) accepted by DIAN customs authority
Bill of Lading (or Air Waybill) proving shipment from Colombian territory to the foreign buyer
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Negociación de Divisas / Formulario No. 5) proving receipt of export proceeds
Electronic export invoice (Factura Electrónica de Venta) with DIAN validation and CUFE/CUDE stamp
Packing List and commercial invoice supporting the customs declaration
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may retrospectively revoke the 0% rate if the export documentation is incomplete, the goods did not exit Colombia, or the proceeds are not collected and repatriated within the 180-day foreign-exchange deadline. In such cases, the VAT becomes 19% on the sale, input VAT is clawed back, and penalties apply under Articles 668/651 of the Tax Code, including up to 100% of the tax omitted, daily interest, and sanctions under the Colombian exchange-control regime; fraudulent export schemes may also be prosecuted as customs crimes.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia), acting jointly with the Comité de Cambios and the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia; the operational foreign-exchange and customs-control counterpart is the DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales). Legal source: Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1068 of 2015, External Circular DCIN-83 of 2020, and the Banco de la República international investment registration regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed floating exchange-rate regime with a broadly liberal current account. Export and import settlements in foreign currency are freely permitted, but all foreign-exchange operations must be routed through the authorized foreign-exchange market by a licensed intermediary, and each transaction must carry the corresponding statistical FX declaration. Current-account transactions are not subject to quantitative approval, but documentary and AML verification apply. Capital-account flows, including foreign direct investment into a Colombian S.A.S., require registration with the Banco de la República. Profit and dividend remittances to non-resident shareholders are permitted without an exchange-control approval hurdle, provided the original FDI is properly registered, the dividend tax has been paid in Colombia, the shareholders has approved the distribution, and the remittance is declared as a capital-account outflow. No special exchange convertibility or residency licence is required for the intraocular lens exporter, but misdeclared purpose codes or unregistered foreign-currency liabilities can trigger fines and bank account restrictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Merchandise export proceeds must be channeled into Colombia through a local authorized intermediary (reintegro) within the term fixed by Banco de la República, which is generally six months from the date of the export customs declaration for standard goods; an extension may be requested and granted before the original deadline. One hundred percent of the declared export FOB value is subject to channeling. Colombia does not mandate a fixed conversion ratio into pesos: the proceeds may be held in a local USD foreign-currency account, deposited in a foreign-currency account abroad only where expressly allowed for treasury management, or converted to COP at the applicable exchange-rate market. The exporter must preserve the DEX customs declaration, bill of lading, commercial invoice, payment evidence, and bank credit advice to substantiate the mandatory FX declaration.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD-COP Account
Operational Account with Trade Finance and Letter of Credit Desk
Operational Account, Export Cash Management and FX Forward Capabilities

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low for offshore digital EMIs (for example Wise or Airwallex) as the sole treasury rail. Under Decree 1068 of 2015 and Circular DCIN-83, only Colombian authorized intermediaries, being banks or licensed payment-company channels settling through a supervised bank, may intermediate foreign-exchange declarations for residents. An offshore EMI cannot hold COP-denominated accounts on behalf of a Colombian resident for export/import operations, cannot submit the required FX and trade declarations, and is not licensed to operate as a clearing bank in Colombia. Offshore EMIs may be used only as ancillary foreign-currency collection accounts outside Colombia, with all funds repatriated thereafter through a tier-1 bank rail into the Colombian S.A.S. onshore account. Local SEDPE fintechs can improve collection speed, but ultimate settlement must go through a licensed commercial bank; using an unlicensed EMI as the principal operating account creates exchange-control and tax-reporting risk.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is not categorically mandated by law; Colombia permits remote electronic KYC under Law 2157 of 2021 and Superintendencia Financiera guidance, subject to the bank's selected authentication method. In practice, for an INVIMA-licensed medical-device manufacturer with non-resident beneficial owners and export payments by LC, tier-1 banks will typically require the legal representative or at least one locally resident director to attend an in-person interview, or to complete a bank-approved notarized video interview. If the sole signer is non-resident or not located in Colombia, banks demand apostilled power of attorney, passport certification, an additional economic nexus check, and often a second interview before activation. The recommended structure is to appoint a Colombian-resident legal representative with full account authority, execute notarized board resolutions in Colombia, and maintain a physical business facility with documented manufacturing operations to satisfy the bank's enhanced due diligence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk industry classification: manufacture and export of medical devices, specifically intraocular acrylic lenses, requires INVIMA sanitary licensing and is treated by compliance as a special-license high-risk customer segment.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle of (i) the INVIMA sanitary product registration or operating authorization, (ii) ISO 13485 quality-management system certificate and sterilization or packaging process validation, (iii) US-FDA establishment registration or CE marking certificate if marketed internationally, (iv) records of the cleanroom facility, lathing equipment and technical files, and (v) an internal compliance manual addressing anticorruption, exports, and medical-device traceability.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering red flags caused by high unit-value niche products: possible mismatch between declared export FOB, letter-of-credit amount, and realistic market price for hydrophobic acrylic intraocular lenses.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent price benchmark analysis from ophthalmic product comparables; full manufacturing cost model showing acrylic raw-material cost per lens, lathe machining yield, coating materials, quality inspection, and overhead; signed framework supply agreements with authorized distributors; independent inspection certificates issued by a recognized surveyor for every LC or MT103 disbursement; and complete customs transport files comprising DEX, commercial invoice, bill of lading, packing list, and customs broker reports.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex or non-resident beneficial ownership of the Colombian S.A.S., raising sanctions, corruption, or ultimate-beneficial-owner concealment concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled and notarized certificate of incorporation and current shareholders register; complete ownership chain from CO_SAS to the ultimate individuals; DIAN Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales certificate or sworn UBO attestation; government-issued identification for each ultimate beneficial owner; shareholder meeting minutes approving bank-account opening and treasury signatory powers; and source-of-funds declarations covering initial cash capital and subsequent injections.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International payment and settlement activity through SWIFT wires and documentary letters of credit involving counterparties or banking jurisdictions classified as high or medium risk for medical-device trade.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formal treasury policy limiting settlements to pre-approved banks and acceptable country lists; mandatory SWIFT remittance information citing invoice numbers and purpose code; complete UCP600 documentary set for each LC covering sales contract, packing list, certificate of origin, insurance, inspection certificates, and quality documentation; KYC file on each end-customer; and periodic independent compliance audit reconciling all wire inflows and outflows against underlying trade invoices and FX declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital contribution structured as in-kind transfer of equipment or machinery instead of cash, potentially creating valuation and source-of-funds uncertainty.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital contribution agreement approved by shareholders; independent machinery appraisal by an internationally recognized equipment valuator; import customs entry and payment evidence for the machinery; board minutes recording the issuance of shares against the in-kind contribution; updated Commercial Registry (Cámara de Comercio) certificate; and tax declaration of the contribution to DIAN showing the value at which the asset enters the S.A.S. accounting records.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) adopt a shareholders' resolution approving the foreign direct investment and the issue or transfer of shares in the Colombian S.A.S.; (2) notify the commercial registry and obtain an updated certificate of existence and legal representation; (3) effect the capital wire through SWIFT MT103 from the investor's bank to a tier-1 Colombian bank, using the beneficiary account registered in the name of the S.A.S. and placing in Field 70 the exact text Capital Contribution FDI for CO_SAS together with the shareholder name and reference number; (4) instruct the receiving bank to credit funds to a USD account and to record the transaction under the Banco de la República Foreign Direct Investment category; (5) require the bank to submit the corresponding international investment declaration and to obtain the central-bank registration acknowledgement before funds are classified as permanent capital; (6) ensure that any conversion from USD to COP is executed through the authorized foreign-exchange market and recorded on the daily exchange-rate registry. The verification bundle for the bank comprises the shareholders' resolution, the notarized capital-correction or subscription agreement, the NIT tax identification certificate, the Cámara de Comercio certificate showing the current authorized capital, evidence of source of funds from the investor, and passport copies of signatories. Use only the official bank-approved purpose code for foreign direct investment; a generic remittance advice may cause the account to be blocked or the capital contribution to be recharacterized as local debt requiring a loan registration.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Export-collection clearing rails comprise SWIFT MT103 direct wire receipts from distributors and ODM buyers into the onshore USD settlement account, and documentary letters of credit confirmed by the buyer's bank. For an LC operation, the Colombian bank issues SWIFT MT700 confirming the credit; the exporter presents documents through the negotiating bank, and payment is received either by MT754 advice or MT202 cover to the onshore account, followed by settlement credit to the USD account. Import disbursements for acrylic raw materials or high-precision lathing equipment are executed by SWIFT MT103 from the USD account for open-account terms, or by issuing an irrevocable, confirmed, sight letter of credit through the local tier-1 bank for high-value equipment; the issuing bank sends MT700, amendments are made by MT707, and the paying bank receives cover after document compliance through MT202 or MT103. All disbursements must reference the commercial invoice and purchase order in Field 70, and the bank must make the corresponding import or export foreign-exchange declaration to DIAN/Banco de la República. Netting of payables and receivables is allowed only if supported by a written reconciliation agreement and declared to the FX authorities; otherwise each trade settlement must be individually wired and documented.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable OTC COP/USD forwards with a Colombian authorized intermediary, limited to hedging documented export receivables or import payables.
COP/USD cross-currency swaps with a local bank, permitted only where the notional matches the actual principal amount of a registered trade exposure or foreign-currency liability.
Plain-vanilla USD call or put options on COP, permissible under the Superintendencia Financiera regime for non-speculative hedging and physical delivery.

Non-deliverable forwards with international banks are permissible only when executed through a Colombian authorized intermediary in accordance with Banco de la República derivative-activity rules and where the underlying exposure is verifiable; otherwise an offshore NDF may be viewed as an exchange-control avoidance instrument.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial registration renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio) of the principal registered domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Between 1 January and 31 March of each year; the renewal is not based on the incorporation anniversary and cannot be submitted after 31 March without penalty.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers an administrative monetary penalty and default interest set by the Chamber of Commerce; continued non-renewal may result in cancellation of commercial registration and loss of merchant legal standing before third parties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval of annual financial statements by the shareholders’ meeting and deposit of signed definitive financial statements with the Chamber of Commerce
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio) of the principal registered domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The annual ordinary shareholders’ meeting must be held by 31 March; the approved financial statements must be deposited with the Chamber of Commerce within the following month, i.e. by 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit the financial statements in time is an administrative infraction punishable by fines imposed by the Chamber of Commerce; the company also cannot rely on those financial statements against third parties until the deposit is made.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in April of the year following the fiscal year; the exact due date depends on the taxpayer’s NIT last digit and DIAN’s official calendar.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of approximately 5% of the tax shown due per month or fraction, with a minimum of 10 UVT, plus daily moratory interest; inaccurate filing can trigger additional DIAN penalties and audits.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual external information report (Información Exógena) covering clients, suppliers, shareholders, and related-party transactions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in June following the taxable year; the exact date is assigned according to the taxpayer’s NIT last digit and DIAN’s published schedule.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file, untimely filing, or submission of erroneous information exposes the company to UVT-indexed fines; repeated non-compliance may lead to tax audits and automatic corrections by DIAN.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ultimate beneficial owner disclosure (Declaración de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 30 June for information as of 31 December of the preceding fiscal year, unless DIAN issues a different NIT-based calendar.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit the UBO declaration or submitting false information is punishable with UVT-based monetary fines and may intensify tax audit scrutiny; each omitted beneficial owner is treated as a separate infraction.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) is mandatory for an S.A.S. if, at the prior year-end, any of the following thresholds is met: gross assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV, gross income exceeds 3,000 SMMLV, more than 30 employees were engaged on average, or the company is a controlling or controlled entity of a group required to present consolidated financial statements. Although ISIC 3250 intraocular lens manufacturing is not itself a regulated financial activity, the company must appoint a Revisor Fiscal if any of these thresholds is satisfied.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards (NIIF) issued under Law 1314 of 2009, aligned with IFRS; entities are classified into Grupo 1, Grupo 2, or Grupo 3 and must apply full IFRS, IFRS for SMEs, or simplified micro-enterprise accounting respectively. Financial statements must be prepared in Spanish and presented in Colombian pesos.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (general CIT, Law 1819/2016 Article 48 and Law 2277/2022 confirmed for fiscal years 2023-2025)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No free-zone holiday. Key benefits: (i) 25% incremental deduction for R&D/technological innovation investments (Art. 158-1 E.T.); (ii) 120% payroll deduction for newly hired low-income employees (Art. 108-1 E.T.); (iii) exemption of 50% of income from sale of new industrial intangible assets created in Colombia (Art. 235-2, numeral 8 E.T.); (iv) accelerated depreciation for fixed assets used in health/scientific production (Art. 140 E.T.). Effective cash rate for a profitable lens manufacturer is approximately 35%, reduced 3-5 points where the R&D and employment deductions are fully utilized.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 (Declaración de Renta y Complementario para Personas Jurídicas y Asimiladas); mandatory e-filing through the DIAN MUISCA portal (www.dian.gov.co) with digital signature; supplementary informative returns: Form 120 (Transfer Pricing), Form 2276/2277 (Información Exógena) and Form 130 (Country-by-Country).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Fiscal year is the calendar year. The DIAN publishes every January a staggered expiry table based on the last two digits of the NIT (tax ID); for ordinary taxpayers the window runs mid-March through April/May of the year following the taxable year; large taxpayers (those with gross income ≥ COP 53,000 million in 2023) file in the April-May window. The 2025 table sets deadlines for FY2024 returns from approximately 11 March to 13 May 2025 depending on NIT digits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross operating revenues from the sale of intraocular acrylic lenses under ISIC 3250, including export sales invoiced via SWIFT/LC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign parent must reconcile its intercompany purchase price with the SAS transfer-pricing study to avoid a clawback on under-billing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold: raw hydrophobic acrylic polymers, precision-lathe tooling depreciation, cleanroom labor, freight and import duties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain full customs and INVIMA-batch records for acrylic raw material costs to substantiate cost-plus TP margins.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses (salaries, INVIMA licensing fees, quality laboratory costs, bank charges, professional fees) and the 25% incremental R&D deduction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Group cost-allocation and management-fee invoices from the parent must satisfy the 15% payments-abroad WHT and the TP benefit test.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offset of prior-year tax losses within the 12-year carryforward period, recomputed with inflationary adjustment per Art. 147 E.T.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign acquirer should verify the unexpired loss carryforward and its inflation-adjusted base before proceeding with an equity purchase of the SAS.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after deductions and leakages (substracting exempt income and special deductions); the base for applying the 35% rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident parent should confirm that no deemed-paid credits (foreign tax imputation) are incorrectly claimed at the SAS level.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT at 35% on the taxable income; add the equality impost (sobretasa) if applicable; reduce by tax credits, prepayments and withholdings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident parent must monitor inflow of dividend WHT certificates issued by the SAS for future FDI credit mapping.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prepayments, withholdings at source suffered on revenues and the standing 100% prepayment covered by ICA/VAT positions; residual balance payable in two installments (75% by the filing deadline, 25% by the deadline set by DIAN, usually August of the same year).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credits can only be claimed against (i) the SAS's own tax credits instrument and (ii) DIAN-issued withholding certificates; foreign parent should ensure adequate documentation trail.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 8a / Saldo a favor o saldo a pagar
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final net tax position of the SAS: if payable, payment via electronic bank deposit to DIAN within the deadline; if a balance in favor (refund), the refund application triggers a prior tax audit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign parent should avoid structuring purchase-price adjustments that create a domestic 'saldo a favor' and thereby expose the SAS to DIAN audit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty (Art. 641 E.T.): 5% of CIT due per each calendar month of delay, capped at 100% of tax due, with a minimum of 10 UVT (COP 497,990 for 2025) where no tax is due; a 50% reduction applies if filed within 12 months of the deadline, and a 75% reduction if within months 12-24. Unpaid tax accrues daily arrears interest at the current bank-lending rate plus 50% (approx. 25%-32% annualized in 2024-2025); failure to submit the Form 120 TP return triggers a separate penalty of 1% of the gross value of the transactions covered, not less than 10 UVT and not exceeding 60,000 UVT.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 5% WHT on dividends paid to non-resident corporate shareholders where the distributed profits have borne Colombian CIT at the 35% rate; 7.5% WHT applies to the portion of profits that enjoyed corporate-level exemptions (Art. 242 E.T.).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A foreign parent invoking DTA protection must obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from its fiscal authority, deliver an official sworn statement confirming beneficial ownership and (in most treaties) a minimum shareholding (usually ≥10%-25%) at the time of distribution, then instruct the Colombian SAS to withhold at the treaty rate. The SAS retains the TRC and dividend-residency evidence on file for DIAN audit for at least five years; no prior DIAN approval is required, but treaty relief may be retrospectively denied where the TRC is missing or beneficial ownership tests fail. Colombia has in-force DTAs with Spain, Chile, Mexico, Portugal, Switzerland, the UK, South Korea, Japan, Canada, and the UAE; the US-Colombia DTA is not in force, so US shareholders remain subject to the statutory 5%/7.5% WHT.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory rates for payments to non-residents (Art. 383, 406 E.T.): 15% WHT on interest on foreign debt; 15% WHT on royalties and technical service fees where the IP is exploited in Colombia; 35% punitive rate applies where the beneficial owner is established in a listed no-tax/zero-tax jurisdiction. In-force DTAs typically cap interest at 10%-15% and royalties at 10%-12% (esp. Spain, Mexico, Switzerland, UK, Chile). The SAS must apply the higher rate unless the TRC and beneficial-ownership certificate for the IP owner are available before payment.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: COP 450,000,000 (approx. USD 110,000 for FY2024; 450,000 UVT threshold updated annually by DIAN) for the aggregate value of cross-border related-party transactions in a fiscal year; exceeding it mandates (i) the Form 120 TP Informative Return and (ii) the full Transfer Pricing Study (Local File) under the OECD-aligned methodology of Arts. 260-1 to 260-11 E.T.; the Master File is required for multinational groups above the DIAN consolidated-revenue threshold and the Country-by-Country report applies where consolidated group revenue exceeds the equivalent of €750 million (COP threshold annually issued by DIAN, approx. COP 2.9 trillion for FY2024).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not operate a formal Economic Substance Regulations filing, but the DIAN applies a GAAR/substance-over-form doctrine under Arts. 869 and 870 E.T., the rule on fictitious companies (Art. 12-1 E.T.) and the sham-transaction doctrine of Art. 9 of Civil Code. A Colombian SAS carrying on ISIC 3250 lens manufacturing must maintain genuine substance: owned/leased cleanroom production infrastructure, qualified manufacturing and QA staff, real procurement and logistics flows, INVIMA medical-device sanitary registration (Registro Sanitario) and a special sanitary license for Class D intraocular implants, and bank accounts matching commercial value. A SAS lacking these elements—while routing lens production or profits abroad—is rebuttable as a façade, enabling DIAN to recharacterize all revenue at 35% plus inexactitude penalties and criminal fraud exposure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting lens sales revenue, creating fictitious acrylic-polymer suppliers, or under-reporting export invoices in the Form 110 while presenting a false taxable income lower than actual; the criminal threshold is met where the tax defrauded exceeds 200 Monthly Minimum Legal Salaries (COP 284.6 million for 2025).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Prison 48-108 months and a fine of 100%-300% of the evaded tax (Criminal Code Art. 434A, as introduced by Law 1819/2016); automatic civil consequence is 'inexactitud' at 100% of the omitted tax (Art. 599 E.T.) plus daily arrears interest; judicial seizure of the SAS assets and freezing of LC/SWIFT settlement accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative and the accounting officer who signed the false return become jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax; personal assets are attachable, the director receives an exit ban (impedimento de salida del país), and may be barred from holding public or corporate office; prison applies personally to directors who authored the fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation and Foreign-Supplier Window Dressing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling intraocular lenses to a foreign distributor at a sub-arm's-length margin, or purchasing acrylic raw materials from tax-haven intermediaries at inflated prices, to shift Colombian profits out of the 35% CIT net.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN administrative adjustment recharacterizing the transactions at the arm's-length price, with additional 35% CIT, moratory interest, and the 100% inexactitude penalty on the differential; submitted false TP documentation can escalate into criminal evasion; the TP Local File must be filed with Form 120 under penalty of 1%-2% of transaction value (min. 10 UVT, max. 60,000 UVT).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve false TP studies or sign intercompany agreements with artificial values are personally liable for the deficits; travel bans and asset embargoes may be ordered during the DIAN audit; in aggravated cases the prosecutor may indict the CFO for fiscal fraud, with imprisonment potential.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fictitious Invoicing and AML Offences (High-Risk Special License)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing or using false invoices to support deductible COGS, committing treasury fraud through over-invoiced import Letters of Credit, or laundering proceeds from unregistered lens sales through SWIFT wire corridors to shell accounts abroad; the commercial model is AML-classified High_Risk_Special_License because medical-device transactions are frequently over/under-invoiced.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: False invoicing (Law 1778/2016, Art. 286 E.T.): prison 60-144 months and a fine up to COP 1,500 million (approx. USD 360,000); aggravated money laundering (Criminal Code Art. 323-325): prison 10-30 years, fine up to 50,000 minimum wages; DIAN may also apply a 100% penalty on the disallowed deduction, and the proceeds are confiscated.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, factoring officers and beneficial owners face personal money-laundering prosecution; broad personal asset confiscation under the unexplained-wealth procedure; mandatory exit bans and a preventive prison during trial for the legal representative who signed the false invoices.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Regulatory Violation — Unlicensed Medical Device Manufacturing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Manufacturing or importing hydrophobic foldable intraocular lenses without the mandatory INVIMA medical-device sanitary registration and the special sanitary license for high-risk (Class D) ophthalmic implants, or tolerating toll-manufacturing abroad while representing the goods as locally produced (failure of economic substance in the health sector).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to COP 1,000 million (approx. USD 240,000), product confiscation, closure of the plant, cancellation of the registry and prohibition to contract with the Colombian state; counterfeit or adulterated device offences attract prison 48-144 months under Criminal Code Arts. 372-373; INVIMA additionally reports the matter to DIAN for the 35% tax recharacterization of undeclared sales.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under Decree 4725/2005 and the INVIMA sanctioning regime, the legal representative is jointly liable for the unauthorised manufacturing activity; personal fines, travel embargoes, public blacklisting and disqualification from the health-products sector apply; the corporate veil of the SAS is pierced because the business is operated without the mandatory special license.
